name: Fiena
source:
Taken in by a family of farmers as an infant, she worked tirelessly, determined not to burden those who had sheltered her. One day, she is led to a magical kingdom, where she is recognized as a holy priestess — the Moon Witch. Overwhelmed by this new role, she finds herself thrust into a world of wonder and confusion. 

[From [url=https://en.loca.games/volontes/]LocaGames[/url]]
